info.name: SmartTeam PIMS API Postman Collection

item.name: [TC-AUTH-010] Users/me must not leak sensitive fields

request.description:
Mapped to: TC-AUTH-010
Data IDs: JWT-001
Purpose: Response must not include passwordHash/resetToken/secret key.

exec: pm.test('No sensitive fields', function(){ const body=pm.response.text(); ['passwordHash','resetToken','secret','privateKey'].forEach(x => pm.expect(body).to.not.include(x)); });

item.name: 04 - AI Matching Engine
item.description: Teammate matching and mentor recommendation APIs with deterministic seed data.

item.name: [TC-AI-001] Find best teammates with complete profile

request.description:
Mapped to: TC-AI-001
Data IDs: AI-TM-001..AI-TM-006, STU-001
Purpose: Return sorted compatibility score list 0-100.

exec: pm.test('Scores in range', function(){ const list=pm.response.json().recommendations || []; list.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.score).to.be.within(0,100)); });

exec: const json=pm.response.json(); const first=(json.recommendations||[])[0]||{}; pm.collectionVariables.set('mentorId', first.mentorId || 'MEN-001');
